idea-plugin.name: Obrigado
idea-plugin.description:
One labeled sponsored line in your status bar while a coding agent is working. 70% of the revenue funds open source maintainers.

The line is rendered by the obrigado command-line client, which you install and configure separately; this plugin draws what it prints. Until the client is installed, the plugin shows nothing and sends nothing. The line appears only while an agent session is live, always carries its disclosure, and can be hidden from the status bar's own menu.
